title: 雅思 6.0-6.5 · 语法专题 8 讲

items.title: 介词 + 关系代词的定语从句
items.ruleText:
结构 **介词 + which / whom**，多见于正式书面语。
介词的选择取决于从句中动词或名词的固定搭配，
如 the extent **to which**、the rate **at which**、the way **in which**。

examples.en: The extent to which media shapes opinion is debated.
examples.cn: 媒体影响舆论的程度仍有争议。

examples.en: The speed at which glaciers retreat has increased.
examples.cn: 冰川退缩的速度加快了。

exercises.stem: This is the framework ______ the analysis is based.
exercises.explanation: be based on → on which。

exercises.stem: She described the manner ______ the interviews were conducted.
exercises.explanation: in the manner → in which。

exercises.stem: 判断：“the reason of which” 是描述原因时的标准搭配。
exercises.explanation: 应为 the reason for which 或直接用 why。

items.title: 让步状语从句的多种表达
items.ruleText:
除 although / though 外，可用 **even if / even though / while / whereas**，
以及倒装让步 **Adjective + as + 主语 + be**。
Despite / In spite of 后接**名词或动名词**，不接从句。

examples.en: Difficult as the task was, the team completed it.
examples.cn: 尽管任务艰巨，团队还是完成了。

examples.en: Despite the delay, the outcome remained positive.
examples.cn: 尽管有延误，结果依然积极。

exercises.stem: ______ the evidence is limited, the argument is persuasive.
exercises.explanation: 后接完整从句，只能用 Although。

exercises.stem: ______ as it seems, the method works reliably.
exercises.explanation: 倒装让步结构：形容词 + as + 主语 + 系动词。

exercises.stem: 判断：“Despite of the rain, the event went ahead.” 语法正确。
exercises.explanation: despite 后不加 of，应为 Despite the rain 或 In spite of the rain。

items.title: 结果与目的状语
items.ruleText:
结果：**so + 形容词 + that**、**such + 名词短语 + that**、so as to（否定用 so as not to）。
目的：**in order that + 从句**、**in order to / so as to + 动词原形**。
注意 so as to 不能置于句首。

examples.en: The instructions were so clear that no one asked questions.
examples.cn: 说明极其清楚，没人提问。

examples.en: In order to reduce waste, the café stopped using plastic cups.
examples.cn: 为减少浪费，咖啡馆停用塑料杯。

exercises.stem: It was ______ a convincing study that policy changed within a year.
exercises.explanation: such + a/an + 形容词 + 名词 + that。

exercises.stem: ______ avoid misunderstanding, define your terms early.
exercises.explanation: so as to 不能置于句首，故选 In order to。

exercises.stem: 判断：so…that 与 such…that 中的 that 引导的是结果状语从句。
exercises.explanation: 两者均为结果状语从句的标志结构。

items.title: 名词化与学术语域
items.ruleText:
名词化把动词或形容词转为名词（analyse→analysis、able→ability），
可提高信息密度与客观性，但**过度使用**会造成句子笨重、可读性下降。
雅思写作建议：关键论点用动词，背景信息可名词化。

examples.en: The introduction of the scheme reduced congestion.
examples.cn: 该方案的实施减少了拥堵。

examples.en: A rapid decline in bird populations followed.
examples.cn: 随后鸟类数量迅速下降。

exercises.stem: 把 “They decided quickly.” 名词化后最自然的一项是：
exercises.explanation: decide → decision，副词 quickly → 形容词 quick。

exercises.stem: 下列哪一句名词化过度、可读性最差？
exercises.explanation: B 层层名词化，主语冗长，动词被弱化为 took place。

options.text: An improvement in the provision of the service by the council took place.
The council made improvements to the service.

exercises.stem: 判断：名词化越多，雅思写作词汇分越高。
exercises.explanation: 评分关注准确与自然，过度名词化反而损害连贯与可读性。

items.title: 被动语态与信息结构
items.ruleText:
英语句子倾向**已知信息在前、新信息在后**。
被动语态常用于把已知信息提到主语位置，从而衔接上下文，
而非单纯为了“显得正式”。

examples.en: These findings were confirmed by a later study.
examples.cn: 这些发现被后来的研究证实。

exercises.stem: 上文刚讨论过 the proposal，下句衔接最好的写法是：
exercises.explanation: 已知信息 the proposal 置于主语位置，衔接最自然。

options.text: The proposal was rejected by the committee.
There was a rejection of the proposal.

exercises.stem: 学术写作中使用被动的主要理由是：
exercises.explanation: 被动的核心功能是信息结构调整。

options.text: 调整信息重心并弱化施动者

exercises.stem: 判断：全篇使用被动语态可以提升语法多样性得分。
exercises.explanation: 单一句式会降低 Grammatical Range 分数，应主被动交替。

items.title: 条件句三型与混合条件
items.ruleText:
真实条件：if + 现在时，主句 will；
非真实（现在）：if + 过去时，主句 would；
非真实（过去）：if + had done，主句 would have done。
**混合条件**：过去的条件 + 现在的结果。

examples.en: If they had invested earlier, they would be profitable now.
examples.cn: 如果他们早些投资，现在就盈利了。

examples.en: If the data were reliable, the conclusion would hold.
examples.cn: 如果数据可靠，结论就能成立。

exercises.stem: If the city had built the line in 2010, traffic ______ far lighter today.
exercises.explanation: 混合条件：过去条件 + 现在结果，主句用 would + 动词原形。

exercises.stem: If sea levels ______ rising, coastal cities will face serious risks.
exercises.explanation: 真实条件句，从句用一般现在时。

exercises.stem: 判断：Were it not for the subsidy, the service would close. 是正确的倒装虚拟句。
exercises.explanation: if 省略后 were 提前，构成正式倒装虚拟条件句。

items.title: 同位语从句与信息补充
items.ruleText:
同位语从句用 that / whether / 疑问词引导，**解释抽象名词的具体内容**，
常见先行名词：fact、idea、belief、evidence、possibility、conclusion。
与定语从句的区别：同位语从句中 that 不作句子成分。

examples.en: The evidence that pollution harms health is overwhelming.
examples.cn: 污染危害健康的证据非常充分。

examples.en: The question whether the policy works remains open.
examples.cn: 该政策是否有效仍是未解问题。

exercises.stem: 下列哪句中的 that 引导同位语从句？
exercises.explanation: B 中 that 从句解释 claim 的内容，不作成分。

options.text: The report that arrived yesterday is detailed.
The claim that the method is flawed needs testing.
The book that she wrote sold well.

exercises.stem: The possibility ______ the trend reverses cannot be ruled out.
exercises.explanation: 同位语从句用 that 引导。

exercises.stem: 判断：同位语从句中的引导词在从句中不充当主语或宾语。
exercises.explanation: 这正是它与定语从句最关键的区别。

items.title: 模糊限制语（Hedging）
items.ruleText:
学术英语避免绝对化。常用手段：情态动词（may / might / could）、
频度与程度副词（often / largely / to some extent）、
动词（suggest / indicate / tend to）与句式（It appears that…）。

examples.en: The results suggest that early intervention may help.
examples.cn: 结果表明早期干预可能有帮助。

examples.en: This factor is, to some extent, beyond individual control.
examples.cn: 这一因素在某种程度上超出个人控制。

exercises.stem: 选出学术语域最恰当的一句：
exercises.explanation: B 使用 may 与 in some contexts 做适度限定。

options.text: Social media definitely destroys teenagers concentration.
Social media may reduce teenagers concentration in some contexts.
Everyone knows social media ruins concentration.

exercises.stem: “The data prove that…” 更严谨的改写是：
exercises.explanation: prove 语气过强，show / indicate / suggest 更稳妥。

exercises.stem: 判断：过度使用 hedging 也可能使论点显得模糊无力。
exercises.explanation: 限定要适度：既不能绝对化，也不能立场不明。
